title: 13 MCP tools implemented, exceeding the required capabilities
evidence: Sources/SoccerKit/Tools.swift:definitions adds derbies, finals, team_profile, biggest_wins, best_records, nationality_clubs, team_competitions beyond the spec's core queries
suggestion: None — spec fully covered plus extras

title: Robust team-name normalization across datasets
evidence: Sources/SoccerKit/Normalize.swift:TeamName.key folds accents, strips state suffixes, and applies club aliases (e.g. 'Sport Club Corinthians Paulista' -> 'corinthians'); tested in Tests/SoccerKitTests/UnitTests.swift:testTeamNameNormalization

title: FIFA dataset omits many Brazilian clubs; player-by-club returns none for e.g. Flamengo
evidence: Sources/SoccerKit/Tools.swift:search_players returns an explanatory message ('some Brazilian clubs such as Flamengo are not included'); asserted in Tests/SoccerKitTests/FeatureTests.swift:testSearchByName
suggestion: None — handled gracefully with a user-facing explanation rather than an error
